vectorforcesmuseum.name: Vector & Forces Museum
vectorforcesmuseum.description: Eight chained halls showing every kept vector and forces artifact, curated from a full audit (doc/VECTOR_FORCES_MUSEUM.md). Small interactive pieces sit on height-2 plinth rows; big pieces get open floor and firing lanes. Foundations, Operations, Motion, Fields, Launch, Springs, Gravity, Arena — the loop closes back at the entrance.
vectorforcesmuseum.qfep_connection: Vectors are the project's first relational handles: every force is a relation made visible. The museum shows the whole vocabulary at once — a field guide rather than a lesson.
vectorforcesmuseum.truth: A force is a vector you can stand inside.
vectorforcesmuseum.content: Curated exhibition of ~86 vector/forces artifacts across 8 themed halls, teleporter-chained in a loop.
vectorforcesmuseum.retired_reason: Retired 2026-08-25. Never a separate curriculum: forces.json listed all eight VFM rooms itself, so this file was a second name for maps that already had one. The museum survives as the BENCH scale of the forces ladder — rungs 1-5 at arm's length, with the walkable Acts as the same rungs at the scale of a building.
